svg.title: ERC-8004 agent identity lifecycle (Identity Registry)
svg.desc: State diagram: ERC-8004 agent identity lifecycle (Identity Registry). 6 states: Not registered, Registered, no URI, Registered with URI, wallet = owner, Wallet verified, Wallet cleared, and Declared inactive (off-chain only). Starts in Not registered. 12 transitions. From Not registered to Registered, no URI when Mint without a URI (register()). From Not registered to Registered with URI, wallet = owner when Mint with a URI (register(agentURI) or register(agentURI, metadata)). From Registered, no URI to Registered with URI, wallet = owner when Owner or operator sets the URI (setAgentURI(agentId, newURI)). From Registered with URI, wallet = owner to Registered with URI, wallet = owner when File moved or edited (setAgentURI(agentId, newURI)). From Registered with URI, wallet = owner to Wallet verified when New wallet signs AgentWalletSet within 5 minutes (setAgentWallet(agentId, newWallet, deadline, signature)). From Wallet verified to Wallet cleared when Owner or operator clears the wallet (unsetAgentWallet(agentId)). From Registered with URI, wallet = owner to Wallet cleared when Token transferred to a new owner (ERC-721 transferFrom or safeTransferFrom). From Wallet verified to Wallet cleared when Token transferred to a new owner (ERC-721 transferFrom or safeTransferFrom). From Wallet cleared to Wallet verified when Current owner binds a wallet again (setAgentWallet(agentId, newWallet, deadline, signature)). From Registered with URI, wallet = owner to Declared inactive (off-chain only) when Owner publishes a file with active false (setAgentURI(agentId, newURI) or an HTTPS file edit). From Wallet verified to Declared inactive (off-chain only) when Owner publishes a file with active false (setAgentURI(agentId, newURI) or an HTTPS file edit). From Declared inactive (off-chain only) to Registered with URI, wallet = owner when Owner publishes a file with active true (setAgentURI(agentId, newURI)).

span.p: register() with no argument; Registered carries an empty agentURI.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: agentWallet defaults to the owner address at mint.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: agentWallet set to another address by setAgentWallet with a signature from that address.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: agentWallet is the zero address after unsetAgentWallet or a transfer.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: active is false in the registration file. The registry has no such state and no burn function, so the token persists.
